description: Integrate the GeoResearch feature into the app: add it to home navigation, add canned demo output so demo mode stays fully usable, localize all its strings across the four .arb files, and add tests. This makes the feature reachable, offline-usable, translated, and covered. Depends on FEAT-003.
steps: Wire navigation. In lib/features/home/application/home_provider.dart add a HomeTab constant/index for GeoResearch (and adjust the profile/other indices consistently). In lib/features/home/presentation/home_screen.dart add the GeoResearchScreen into the IndexedStack children in the SAME order as the NavigationBar destinations, add a NavigationDestination (choose a fitting Material icon, e.g. Icons.terrain_outlined / Icons.terrain or Icons.landscape_outlined / Icons.landscape, or Icons.science_outlined) with an l10n label, and extend _titleFor() to return the new tab's title. Verify the PopScope 'back returns to Chat' logic and IndexedStack index bounds still hold with the extra tab. Note: NavigationBar with 5 destinations is fine in Material 3.

Add demo output. In lib/core/services/demo_ai_gateway.dart, the DemoAiGateway currently returns diagnosis JSON for any jsonMode request. Distinguish the soil-research request from the diagnosis request (e.g. by detecting a marker substring that AiPrompts.soilResearchInstruction() includes in the userText/systemPrompt) and return a deterministic, valid SoilReport JSON (populating soil type, estimated depth, salinity/sodium levels, N/P/K nutrients, pH, organic matter, a couple of substances, a geometry/structure description, suitable plants, recommendations, safety notes, conservative confidence, and the estimate/lab-test disclaimer). Keep the existing diagnosis demo path working. Ensure the demo JSON parses cleanly via SoilReport.parse.

Localize. Add all new user-facing GeoResearch strings (tab label, title, screen labels/buttons, result card section headings, level chips low/medium/high if not already present, disclaimer text, follow-up CTA) and the FEAT-002 reminder body keys to lib/l10n/app_en.arb (template, with @-metadata/placeholders where needed). Mirror every new key into app_ar.arb (Arabic translation), app_fr.arb and app_es.arb (English fallback values are acceptable per the existing partial-translation convention, but the KEYS must exist in all files that already carry them; match how existing keys are distributed across the arb files). Replace any temporary literal strings left in FEAT-003's UI with AppLocalizations getters. Run `flutter pub get` (or `flutter gen-l10n`) to regenerate lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart. Do NOT hand-edit the generated Dart.

Add tests. Create test/unit/soil_report_parse_test.dart mirroring test/unit/diagnosis_parse_test.dart: assert SoilReport.parse handles clean JSON, ```json-fenced JSON with surrounding prose, and malformed/partial JSON (graceful degradation or FormatException as designed). If practical, add a small provider or service test using a fake AiGateway (see test/mocks/mocks.dart and test/widgets/test_app.dart) verifying SoilResearchService.analyze returns a populated SoilReport for canned gateway output and surfaces AppException on malformed output. Follow existing test conventions; do not contact any network.

Run the full gate: `flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test`. Fix everything until analyze is clean and all tests (existing + new) pass. Confirm the new tab renders (analyze-level / widget-test level; no device build needed).
acceptance_criteria: GeoResearch is reachable as a home tab (added to IndexedStack + NavigationBar + _titleFor with an l10n label), and tab indices/titles remain consistent
Demo mode returns valid SoilReport JSON for the soil-research request (SoilReport.parse succeeds) while diagnosis demo output still works
All GeoResearch strings and the reminder-body strings exist in app_en.arb and are mirrored into app_ar/app_fr/app_es per convention; generated AppLocalizations compiles
test/unit/soil_report_parse_test.dart exists and passes, covering clean, fenced-with-prose, and malformed JSON
`flutter analyze` reports 'No issues found!' and `flutter test` passes all tests
verification: export PATH="/opt/flutter-sdk/bin:$PATH" && flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test
findings: Wired GeoResearch into the app, added demo output, and added tests. Localization keys (georesearch* + navGeoResearch + georesearchTitle + reminder bodies) were already fully added and mirrored across app_en/ar/fr/es.arb by FEAT-003 and regenerate cleanly, so no .arb changes were needed here; verified every l10n getter referenced by the georesearch UI exists in all four arb files. Changes: (1) NAVIGATION — lib/features/home/application/home_provider.dart: inserted HomeTab.georesearch=2 and shifted weather=3/profile=4 (chat=0, diagnose=1 unchanged). lib/features/home/presentation/home_screen.dart: imported GeoResearchScreen, added it to the IndexedStack children at index 2 (matching NavigationBar order), added a NavigationDestination with Icons.terrain_outlined/Icons.terrain and l10n.navGeoResearch at position 2, and extended _titleFor() to return l10n.georesearchTitle for HomeTab.georesearch. IndexedStack now has 5 children (indices 0-4, valid); NavigationBar has 5 destinations (valid in Material 3); PopScope 'back returns to Chat' logic (canPop: tab==HomeTab.chat) remains correct. (2) DEMO OUTPUT — lib/core/services/demo_ai_gateway.dart: imported ai_prompts.dart; in generate() jsonMode branch, detect soil-research via _isSoilResearch() which matches AiPrompts.soilResearchMarker ('PLANTSENSE_SOIL_RESEARCH_V1') in userText/systemPrompt and return new _demoSoilReportJson() — a deterministic, valid SoilReport JSON (soil type, estimated depth, low salinity+sodium with lab-test notes, N/P/K nutrients, ~neutral pH, moderate organic matter, carbonates+clay substances, geometry description that adapts to image presence, suitable plants, recommendations incl. professional soil-lab test, safety notes incl. geotechnical survey warning, conservative 'low' confidence, estimate/lab-test disclaimer). Diagnosis demo path unchanged for non-soil jsonMode requests. Demo JSON parses cleanly via SoilReport.parse (asserted in test). (3) TESTS — created test/unit/soil_report_parse_test.dart (6 tests: clean JSON, ```json-fenced-with-prose, missing optional fields, FormatException on non-JSON, unknown-enum safe defaults, nameless nutrient/substance filtering) mirroring diagnosis_parse_test.dart; created test/unit/soil_research_service_test.dart (4 tests using FakeAiGateway + DemoAiGateway: populated SoilReport from canned output with jsonMode+marker+enriched lat/lon context assertions, AppException(malformedResponse) on bad output, DemoAiGateway returns a parseable populated SoilReport for soil requests, DemoAiGateway still returns diagnosis JSON for non-soil requests). functions/ untouched; no android/ios dirs created; no network in tests. VERIFICATION: `flutter pub get && flutter analyze` -> 'No issues found!'; `flutter test` -> All tests passed! 71 tests (61 existing + 10 new).
